articles.body: LaLiga 26-27 sigue su curso y el domingo llega con cuatro partidos tremendamente interesantes. El primero será el Celta de Vigo vs Málaga a las 14:00. Seguido de este, el Levante se enfrenta al FC Barcelona a las 16:15. Más tarde tenemos el partido entre el Getafe y el Deportivo de A Coruña. A las 21:00 de la noche tenemos el Real Sociedad vs Atlético de Madrid. Pronóstico 1: Gana el Celta de Vigo Se enfrentan dos equipos que todavía no saben lo que es ganar esta temporada. El Celta de Vigo juega en casa, con su gente, y tratará de derrotar a un Málaga que ha mostrado alguna que otra debilidad defensiva. Betfair paga a 1.7 la victoria local. Pronóstico 2: Gana el FC Barcelona al descanso El mercado de ganador al descanso aparece como la alternativa más clara del encuentro en las apuestas deportivas. El Barcelona ha ganado sus cuatro partidos disputados en LaLiga con un arrollador balance de 17 goles a favor y solo dos en contra, y llega además de golear 5-1 al Feyenoord en su debut en la Champions League. El Levante, por su parte, atraviesa una buena racha sin conocer la derrota y sabe hacer daño en su feudo, pero el desnivel de plantillas es notable. Betfair paga a 1.42 la victoria azulgrana a la media parte. Pronóstico 3: Más de 1.5 goles El mercado de goles apunta hacia un partido con cierta producción ofensiva pese a las urgencias del Getafe. El conjunto de Bordalás llega decimoquinto con solo dos goles marcados y cinco encajados en sus primeras cuatro jornadas, un dato que invita a pensar en un partido abierto ante las llegadas rivales. El Deportivo, en cambio, se mantiene invicto y quinto clasificado tras sumar ocho goles en ese mismo tramo, incluyendo el reciente 2-3 firmado en La Cerámica ante el Villarreal. Betfair paga a 1.58 que el encuentro supere la línea de 1.5 goles. Pronóstico 4: Ambos equipos marcan El mercado de ambos equipos marcan se perfila como una de las opciones más atractivas de la jornada. El Atlético de Madrid llega golpeado tras encadenar dos derrotas consecutivas, la primera por 3-0 en San Mamés ante el Athletic Club y la segunda por 2-1 frente al Liverpool en su estreno en la Champions League, lo que aumenta la necesidad de reaccionar con gol en Anoeta. La Real Sociedad, por su parte, atraviesa un buen momento de juego y no conoce la derrota en sus últimos tres compromisos, aunque su defensa tampoco ha sido un muro esta temporada. Betfair paga a 1.46 que ambos equipos anoten. La combinada propuesta para esta jornada de LaLiga reúne la victoria del Celta de Vigo (1.7), la del FC Barcelona al descanso ante el Levante (1.42), que el Getafe vs Deportivo tenga más de 1.5 goles (1.58) y que ambos equipos marquen en el Real Sociedad vs Atlético de Madrid (1.46). La cuota combinada asciende hasta 4.35, fruto de la multiplicación de las tres cuotas. articles.title: Pouso de emergência em Goiânia: Relato de pânico em voo da Gol | G1
articles.standfirst: Aeronave saiu de Goiânia e tinha com destino Congonhas, em São Paulo, mas precisou fazer pouco de emergência. A Gol Linhas Aéreas informou que o voo foi cancelado após apresentar problemas técnicos.
articles.summary: Pouso de emergência em Goiânia ocorreu após problemas técnicos em voo da Gol para Congonhas, com passageiros relatando momentos de pânico e falta de informação.
articles.body:
O passageiro Rafael Grabowski, que estava no avião que fez um pouso de emergência em Goiânia , relatou momentos de pânico dentro da aeronave e descreveu que "foi uma situação bem aterrorizante". Segundo ele, logo depois da decolagem, um forte estrondo foi ouvido na lateral do avião, que transportava 180 pessoas e havia partido da capital goiana com destino ao Aeroporto de Congonhas, em São Paulo, na manhã deste sábado (12).

"Foi uma situação bem aterrorizante, porque logo depois que a gente decolou, em torno de 20 minutos no máximo, a gente escutou um estrondo muito grande na lateral esquerda do avião e, de repente, as máscaras começaram a cair. Foi, assim, cena de terror", disse.

De acordo com Rafael, o que deixou os passageiros ainda mais apreensivos foi a falta de comunicação da tripulação durante o incidente.

"Eu acho que o mais difícil para a gente foi o fato de ninguém falar nada. Todo mundo ficou apreensivo, gritando, com gente passando mal, e nada era comunicado. O avião deu a sensação de queda por alguns minutos, então ficamos muito aterrorizados nesse momento", descreveu o passageiro.

Avião faz pouso forçado em Gioânia logo após decolar — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhaguera

Segundo o Aeroporto Internacional de Goiânia, a aeronave da Gol, com 174 passageiros e seis tripulantes, partiu de Goiânia com destino ao Aeroporto de Congonhas, em São Paulo, mas declarou emergência e retornou ao aeroporto de Goiânia, onde recebeu apoio durante o pouso. De acordo com o aeroporto, a aeronave pousou normalmente, sem intercorrências (leia nota completa no final da maté) . A administração informou ainda que a companhia aérea presta suporte aos passageiros.

Segundo apuração da TV Anhanguera, a aeronave ficou cerca de 45 minutos no ar antes de retornar ao Aeroporto de Goiânia. Imagens do site FlightRadar mostram que a aeronave deu ao menos dez voltas após a decolagem, antes de retornar para Goiânia.

Em nota, a Gol Linhas Aéreas informou que o voo foi cancelado após apresentar problemas técnicos. A companhia afirmou que todas as medidas operacionais foram adotadas com foco na segurança e que os passageiros impactados recebem o suporte previsto nas normas da Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Anac) (veja a nota na íntegra no final da matéria) .

"O Aeroporto de Goiânia informa que uma aeronave da GOL que decolou com destino a São Paulo (Congonhas) retornou ao terminal após declaração de emergência pela tripulação. O pouso ocorreu normalmente e em total segurança, sem registro de intercorrências. A operação recebeu o apoio previsto nos protocolos aeroportuários, e a companhia aérea está prestando assistência aos passageiros."

"A GOL informa que, na manhã deste sábado (12/09), a aeronave do voo G3 1433, entre o aeroporto de Goiânia (GYN) e Congonhas (CGH), apresentou problemas técnicos e, após retornar ao aeroporto goiano, teve seu voo cancelado.

A Companhia reforça que todas as ações relacionadas a operação foram tomadas com foco na Segurança, valor número 1 da GOL.

Todos os Clientes impactados estão recebendo as tratativas previstas pela Resolução 400 da ANAC, conforme suas necessidades."

articles.title: Centro de treinamento da base do São Paulo fica alagado após fortes chuvas em Cotia, na Grande SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Jogos das equipes Sub-15, Sub-17 e Sub-20 pelo Campeonato Paulista foram adiados. Cotia foi o município paulista com o maior volume acumulado de chuva nas últimas 48 horas, segundo balanço da Defesa Civil.
articles.summary: Jogos das equipes Sub-15, Sub-17 e Sub-20 pelo Campeonato Paulista foram adiados. Cotia foi o município paulista com o maior volume acumulado de chuva nas últimas 48 horas, segundo balanço da Defesa Civil.
articles.body:
O centro de treinamento das categorias de base do São Paulo Futebol Clube, em Cotia, na Grande São Paulo, ficou completamente alagado após as fortes chuvas que atingiram a região. — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

O centro de treinamento das categorias de base do São Paulo Futebol Clube, em Cotia, na Grande São Paulo, ficou completamente alagado após as fortes chuvas que atingiram a região. Em uma imagem aérea, é possível ver grandes áreas do CFA Laudo Natel tomadas pela água neste sábado (12).

Cotia foi o município paulista com o maior volume acumulado de chuva nas últimas 48 horas, segundo balanço da Defesa Civil do Estado de São Paulo. Foram registrados 151 milímetros de chuva no período, sendo 85 milímetros somente nas últimas 24 horas (leia mais abaixo).

Por causa das condições do local e por medida de segurança, três partidas das categorias de base do São Paulo que seriam realizadas no centro de treinamento pelo Campeonato Paulista foram adiadas.

O jogo do Sub-15 contra o Amparo foi o único que chegou a começar. A partida, porém, foi interrompida no intervalo. O São Paulo vencia por 3 a 0, com dois gols de Yahgo e um de Juninho. Na sequência, o Sub-17 enfrentaria o Independente, mas a partida também foi adiada.

Já no período da tarde, o Sub-20 do São Paulo enfrentaria o São João, às 15h. A realização do jogo estava em análise por causa das condições climáticas, mas a equipe de arbitragem optou pelo adiamento.

As novas datas e horários das partidas serão definidos posteriormente pela Federação Paulista de Futebol.

As chuvas começaram a atingir a cidade com maior intensidade na noite de sexta-feira (11) e provocaram ocorrências em diferentes regiões.

Entre os pontos mais afetados estão Jardim Sandra, São Miguel, Lajeado, Água Espraiada, Rio Cotia e Jardim Cotia.

Desde a madrugada deste sábado, equipes da Defesa Civil, da Secretaria de Obras e do Comitê de Gerenciamento da Prefeitura de Cotia atuam nos locais atingidos para atender ocorrências, realizar vistorias, desobstruções e intervenções emergenciais.

A prefeitura informou que mantém o monitoramento das condições climáticas e das áreas consideradas mais vulneráveis e que as equipes permanecem de prontidão enquanto persistirem as condições de instabilidade.

articles.title: New system, same problems - Xabi Alonso 'unhappy' with 'soft' Chelsea
articles.summary: It was subdued at Stamford Bridge after Chelsea's 2-2 draw with newly promoted Hull City.
articles.body:
It was a familiar story for the Premier League's top scorers.

Chelsea's entertaining 2-2 draw with Hull on Saturday means the Blues have now found the net 10 times this season - but they have also conceded two or more goals in each of their opening four league matches for the first time in 11 years.

Only Crystal Palace and Ipswich Town have conceded more than Chelsea 's nine goals in the top flight so far this season.

The issue predates manager Xabi Alonso's arrival. Chelsea are now without a clean sheet in 20 league matches stretching back to January, their longest such run for 65 years.

Alonso still appears to be experimenting. This week alone, he changed shape in three successive matches - from the defeat at Arsenal to the 6-3 Carabao Cup win over Leeds in midweek and again against Hull.

Yet it was Hull who looked more likely to find a winner. No wonder there was a subdued mood at Stamford Bridge.

Alonso summed up the feeling afterwards, saying his side needed to be "competing better" and avoid being "soft" in duels.

Jorrel Hato misjudged a cross before Hull scored their equaliser, while Mohamed Belloumi's second goal came after Chelsea failed to clear a corner.

Despite an early goal from Morgan Rogers and a second-half equaliser from Joao Pedro, with Cole Palmer involved in both strikes, Chelsea had to settle for a point.

Hull boss Sergej Jakirovic even described Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez as the "man of the match" after the Argentine denied Oli McBurnie, Mohamed-Ali Cho and Lucas Herrington.

Asked about Chelsea 's defensive issues, former defender and BBC pundit Ashley Williams said: " Chelsea are all over the place in transitions. When they lose the ball, they are wide open. The goals they conceded are just basic errors.

"Both individually and as a defensive unit, they are so far off it and are shipping goals. They are not going to achieve what they want this season defending like that."

With Rogers, Palmer and Joao Pedro in fine form offensively this season, the Blues know they need to find solutions defensively.

Alonso said: "We had one or two good chances to get the winner, but you're still open. Not happy. We can do better. We got what we deserved.

"We need to be more solid and be more controlled. [We have] new players and new staff. This is the process. In a few months I'm sure we'll be able to control better."

However, he said his decision to switch to a back four was not a solution to recent defensive issues, explaining: "It's about the profile of the players.

"You can say it was back three or four, so it's about the choice of the players, their qualities, where they play better.

"Today we played with Malo [Gusto], he was playing in good positions, trying to find him and on the right linking with other players, so it wasn't that much of a change for me."

It was a "tactical" decision to take Hato off at half-time, he continued, before going into more detail about what it will take to fix Chelsea 's issues.

"It's all maybe entertaining, but I hope that one day you say it was a boring game and we win and we don't give these entertaining moments," Alonso added. "But for sure it kind of repeats some patterns that we are making.

"It will take time or it will take moments to fix them when we get the lead and you still need to be competing and not to give the chance so easily for them to come back. Especially in the first goal, we can do much better.

"It was too soft to give them this hope because until then we were controlling, we were creating chances, but that momentum that we had changed the mood and the score of the game and it's something that we need to be talking [about], we address and we will get better, but it's having an impact on our performances at the moment."

There will be concerns going into the trip to Brentford on Friday, the last match before the three-week international break, given that the Bees are known to be dangerous at set-pieces.

It's not just set-pieces, though. Chelsea have conceded the majority of the goals from open play, which is something Alonso acknowledged.

"Overall, I think that we are attacking better than defending in every part," he continued.

"We know that it's a big topic and a big theme for us. For sure it's just four games, but the dynamic in terms of conceding, I don't like it and we need to do much better. Open play, set-pieces, long balls, this toughness, this competitive sense, we can do better."

Some players, like Malo Gusto, have been criticised by supporters, and his substitution was celebrated by his own fans inside Stamford Bridge.

Meanwhile, with Moises Caicedo out injured, Chelsea have looked short of quality and numbers in the middle of the park.

Monaco pulled the plug on Chelsea 's £47m deal to sign midfielder Lamine Camara on deadline day, having made attempts to sign Roma's Manu Kone and Fulham 's Sander Berge as alternative options.

Key defensive signing Maxence Lacroix was left out on Saturday but none of the defensive options have excelled this season, although their attack remain in blistering form.

It will be on Alonso to fix these problems on the training pitch with no more opportunities to sign players until the January transfer window.

articles.title: El Elche suma y se hace bola
articles.standfirst: Los de Anselmi, que siguen sin ganar, echan agua en el incendio que quería el Athletic
articles.summary: Los de Anselmi, que siguen sin ganar, echan agua en el incendio que quería el Athletic
articles.body: El Athletic ya colecciona todos los resultados posibles en sus tres primeros partidos de San Mamés: derrota (Sevilla), victoria (Atlético) y el empate de este sábado con el Elche. Los leones necesitaron quince disparos para acertar con el marco de Dituro. Berenguer, con un remate que golpeó en Chust, marcó el tanto del empate ante un Elche que se había puesto en ventaja con un penalti lanzado por Buonanotte en la primera llegada de los blanquiverdes. El Elche sigue sin ganar y el Athletic frena lo que pretendía ser un salto en la clasificación. La primera parte se fue como empezó. Sin goles y con apenas chispazos de emoción. Los que hubo en ese tiempo siempre fueron a lomos del Athletic, bien por las entradas por banda de Nico, por un caño espectacular de Iñaki a Redondo o por la insistencia de Yuri, al que no acompañaron los remates, pero el guiso quedó sin sustancia. El Athletic rozó el gol ante un Elche que en ocasiones llegó a tirar una línea de siete frente a Dituro, pero el discutido portero ilicitano, el mismo al que Anselmi defendió de víspera cuando la hinchada del Elche pedía su relevo, sólo tocó un balón en el primer acto. Fue tras un remate de Robert Navarro después de una buena jugada de Nico en la que el árbitro concedió saque de puerta y desde el VAR nadie reconvino para advertir que había sido córner. La paró. Vaya que la paró. Con todo, la mejor opción del Athletic fue un intento en el minuto 7 de Iñaki Williams tras un muy buen servicio de Sancet que el ya exinternacional con Ghana cazó en mala posición y remató desviado. ¿Y el Elche? Lo mismo que una puesta de sol en la playa de Ilbarritz: esperar a verla sentado. Lo que vino después del descanso cambió de plano el signo del partido. En la primera llegada seria al área del Elche con más de dos tipos en área de remate Areso hizo penalti a Germán Varela y Buonanotte clavó el lanzamiento por la escuadra. El 0-1 sonaba exagerado para los méritos de los blanquiverdes, pero lo tenían. Y entonces arrancó otro partido diferente en el que apareció una cierta ansiedad en los leones ante un rival que soñaba el triunfo que llevaba un mes buscando. Quizá hasta ese punto de intranquilidad de llegó también a Terzic, que igual que frente al Sevilla fulminó a Areso. Dio entrada a Johaneko, que lo mismo juega en un lado que en el otro, por delante o por detrás. En la anhelada revolución hacia la remontada a Terzic le dio por no agotar los cambios -hizo 4- y se quedó fiel a su propuesta. El Elche consiguió sobrevivir sin grandes agobios.

articles.title: Terzic: "No es un paso atrás"
articles.standfirst: El técnico alemán echó en falta eficiencia y remate, pero considera que hay un buen trabajo
articles.summary: El técnico alemán echó en falta eficiencia y remate, pero considera que hay un buen trabajo
articles.body: El empate ante el Elche no cambia el gesto de Terzic. “Una vez más, me gusta separar el resultado y la actuación. En la primera mitad la actuación ha sido un paso adelante. He visto a un equipo que quería más y no veo que haya sido un paso atrás. Es importante aprender de este partido y tener una mejor actuación el miércoles”, dijo. El déficit del equipo: “No es fácil responder. En la primera mitad nos ha faltado el gol y en la segunda no hemos controlado el partido como en el inicio. Hay que ver que concedimos el penalti y estábamos por debajo en el marcador. Creo que en la segunda mitad ha habido buenos momentos y siempre he pensado que podíamos marcar ese gol. Hemos luchado para ganar, pero nos ha faltado profundidad y cambiar de izquierda a derecha. Lo vamos a conseguir". Aprender del partido: “Se pueden sacar conclusiones positivas. He visto a un equipo que ha dominado más que ante el Atlético, donde sufrimos en varios momentos. Hemos dominado y presionado más. Creamos muchos momentos en los que cambiamos de lado en nuestros ataques. Nos ha faltado eficiencia y el último toque, pero estamos en la posición de juego que debemos estar. Quizá tengamos que ser más rápidos en las acciones del primer palo. Vamos a aprender de esto”. La velocidad del partido: "Me hubiera gustado tener más carreras por detrás de la defensa. No hemos tenido espacio y cuando no puedes correr rápido hay que mover rápido el balón, que es algo en lo que trabajamos a diario. Hemos rematado mucho más y hemos tenido más posesión en zonas peligrosas, pero debemos crear momentos claves para nosotros. Tampoco debe ocurrir que concedas un penalti en la situación que hemos tenido". El estado físico de Iñaki: "Es pronto para saber qué ocurrirá. Ha recibido un golpe en el pie y hay que esperar para ver cómo evoluciona. He hablado con él y no me ha dado malas sensaciones. Ha sido doloroso al inicio". El mensaje a la afición: "No diría que el rival no ha sido fuerte. El Elche ha jugado un buen partido y todos nuestros partidos han sido apretados. No estamos satisfechos con el resultado, pero el equipo ha luchado mucho para ganarlo. Me gustaría prometer victorias siempre, pero esto no es el mundo del fútbol. Que no se preocupen porque el miércoles el equipo también peleará por ganar en Levante".

articles.title: Mbappé recupera la puntería con los penaltis y se coloca en lo alto del Pichihi
articles.standfirst: El galo anotó dos tantos ante el Rayo Vallecano y se cuela en el top por el trofeo de máximo goleador liguero
articles.summary: El galo anotó dos tantos ante el Rayo Vallecano y se cuela en el top por el trofeo de máximo goleador liguero
articles.body: Tan solo 14 minutos tardó Kylian Mbappé en volver a apuntarse un nuevo tanto en Liga. Tras fallar el penalti en La Cartuja, el galo se redimió anotando desde los once metros en el duelo ante el Rayo Vallecano. Carreras corrió por la derecha, se internó en el área y Lejeune zancadilleó la progresión del lateral. No tuvo dudas el colegiado García Verdura, que señaló el punto fatídico. Tampoco Kylian, que definió a la izquierda de Audero, engañando al meta que hoy debutaba como titular en el cuadro rayista. Después de una segunda parte con poco fútbol, todo cambió con la entrada de Arda Güler. El turco dispuso de varias ocasiones que agitaron por completo el partido, aunque no llegó a materializar. Sin embargo, un contragolpe en el descuento iniciado por Camavinga llegó a las botas del 15 y este vio rápido por la derecha a Kylian, que le pegó raso para hacer el 4-1. Ya son seis tantos los que suma Kylian Mbappé en esta Liga, uno por detrás de Raphinha y Camello, que anotó el 3-1 en la segunda parte. El francés superó así a Zabiri y Roberto Fernández. Mbappé está a tan solo 8 goles de alcanzar la redonda cifra de los 100 con el Real Madrid en poco más de dos temporadas. El máximo goleador del club, Cristiano Ronaldo, llegó por fechas similares a ese número. Fue el 2 de noviembre, con 105 partidos jugados y bajo las órdenes del que es ahora el entrenador del Madrid, José Mourinho. Ahora Kylian tiene seis jornadas ligueras y dos partidos de Champions para llegar a los 100, algo que parece más que factible teniendo en cuenta su ritmo goleador.

articles.summary: Joao Félix fue el mejor del equipo y CR7 no tuvo grandes ocasiones
articles.body: Al Nassr apenas pudo pasar del empate (1-1) ante un correosoo Khaleej, que le llevó al límite y le sacó un empate, si bien los de Cristiano jugaban fuera de casa. El exmallorquinista Omar Mascarell fue el autor el 1-0 en el descuento del descanso, mientras que Al Nassr empató con gol del 9 del equipo, Abdullah Al Hamddan. Cristiano jugó los 90 minutos, pero no tuvo grandes ocasiones parta poner una muesca más en su idea de llegar a los 1.000 tantos. También jugó Joao Félix, que reaparecía tras estar ausente en el último choque. Con este resultado, Al Nassr se queda en el tercer lugar de la tabla, un punto menos que Ittihad y dos menos que el líder, Hilal, que goleó con un 'hat-trick' del ex del Arsenal, Gabriel Martinelli.

articles.title: Michigan's defense stifles No. 11 Oklahoma's offense in 17-10 upset win
articles.summary: The Wolverines did not need any help from instant replay this time.
articles.body:
Michigan did not need any clock discrepancies to go its way against Oklahoma .

A week after one of the most incredulous endings in college football history , the Wolverines ' defense again starred as Michigan upset No. 11 Oklahoma 17-10 in Ann Arbor. With an offense stalled out for much of the second half, Michigan's go-ahead score came courtesy of a short field.

Jyaire Hill picked off a poor John Mateer pass and returned the ball 24 yards to Oklahoma's 6-yard line. Two plays later, Jordan Marshall was in the end zone and the Wolverines had their game-winning margin.

With just less than eight minutes to go, Oklahoma had plenty of time to get a game-tying score. Instead, the Sooners ' offense ran nine plays over its next two possessions. The first ended in a punt. The second ended in a turnover on downs at midfield without even getting a first down.

After forcing a Michigan punt with 1:14 to go, Oklahoma had no timeouts remaining and needed a touchdown to have the chance of thinking about going for the tie or a game-winning PAT.

The Sooners' offense didn't get close as Mateer was sacked at his own 24-yard line as time expired.

Michigan's offense still has question marks

The Wolverines had fewer than 200 yards of offense last week before their final 75-yard drive that ended in a game-winning Hail Mary with an added second on the clock in their 13-12 Week 1 win over Western Michigan . QB Bryce Underwood had thrown for fewer than 100 yards before that drive and ended with 170 after two completions to JJ Buchanan .

This week, Michigan coach Kyle Whittingham said that Underwood's grip on the starting job was "not infinite" and Underwood claimed to not know that his coach had made those comments in his news conference days later.

On Saturday, a win dissipated any tensions that might have remained from Week 1.

"Great response by Bryce, he played an excellent game," Whittingham told Fox after the game.

But while Michigan's offense did enough to get the win on Saturday, it still doesn't look very dangerous. The Wolverines had 263 yards on 58 plays against the Sooners. Underwood was 9-of-17 passing for 111 yards and rushed 18 times for 87 yards after a 38-yard TD in the first quarter opened the scoring.

Much of Underwood's passing yardage came after the catch, too. The Michigan offense under first-year coordinator Jason Beck is very much a work in progress. Though there will be at least a bit more patience now that Michigan is 2-0 and likely to get back into the AP Top 25 on Sunday.

Where's the Oklahoma offense from September of 2025?

Many of the same questions can be asked of the Oklahoma offense. And it feels like much more than a year ago when Mateer was the Heisman favorite.

Mateer was college football's breakout star of September in 2025 when he had seven passing TDs and five rushing TDs across Oklahoma's first four games of the season. That stretch included a 24-13 win over Michigan where Mateer had three total touchdowns, and a 24-17 win over Auburn as Mateer completed 67% of his passes for 271 yards and had two total touchdowns.

But the Washington State transfer suffered a right thumb injury in that win over the Tigers and he, along with the Oklahoma offense, never looked the same the rest of the year.

The Sooners made it to the playoff on the heels of a dominant defense. They may have to ride that defense again unless Mateer and his teammates can rediscover that form. Mateer was just 17-of-33 passing for 189 yards and was also the team's leading rusher with 13 carries for 45 yards.

Making the playoff in 2026 is now already a far tougher task than it was entering the season. After a game against New Mexico in Week 3, Oklahoma visits No. 2 Georgia before a bye week ahead of its annual rivalry game with No. 4 Texas .

articles.title: Sunderland v Arsenal: How the players rated
articles.summary: How Sunderland and Arsenal players rated following their Premier League match.
articles.body:
Bruno Guimaraes' thunderbolt - 121 seconds after David Raya saved a penalty - helped a sub-par Arsenal maintain their 100% start to their Premier League title defence with a 2-0 win against Sunderland .

Here's how I rated the players and you can see how you scored them below.

Arsenal's brilliance at both ends helps overcome Sunderland

What do BBC Sport's player ratings mean?

Robin Roefs : Poor distribution - two goal-kicks went straight out of play. Hardly troubled in the first half but made a fine save to tip over Kai Havertz's acrobatic effort. 6

Thomas Meunier: Offered a threat on second balls from set pieces but couldn't covert a couple of half chances. Tracked back to help defensively. 6

Nordi Mukiele: Kept Christos Tzolis quiet and provided a good outlet on break, but didn't pick out the right passes. Weak shot when right in front of goal at 1-0 down. Forced Raya into saves with two late chances but should have scored the second. 6

Kevin Danso: An unspectacular but assured home debut. 6

Dan Ballard: Defensively solid as ever and coped well with Arsenal 's press. Should have scored from Xhaka free-kick, but won a penalty. 7

Reinildo Mandava: Largely contained Bukayo Saka, though was baited into fouling him and getting booked. Conceded late penalty and sent off. 4

Nilson Angulo: Lively on the wing and diligent in tracking back, but he should have run at Ben White and Ezri Konsa more. 6

Noah Sadiki: Showed willingness to get forward but also track back, but final ball lacked quality. 6

Granit Xhaka: Produced quality set-piece deliveries and busy as ever in midfield. Made a goal-saving clearance with the last kick of the first half. 7

Enzo Le Fee: Alert and always eager to drive attacks, but telegraphed his soft penalty. 6

Brian Brobbey: Made the lives of Konsa and White miserable all evening with his strength and hold-up play. Created space for others but didn't get any shots away, though that wasn't his brief tonight. 7

Subs not used: Dayann Methalie, Chemsdine Talbi, Chris Rigg, Luke O'Nien, Omar Alderete, Melker Ellborg, Trai Hulme.

David Raya : Little to do until he made a superb penalty save with Arsenal struggling. 8

Ben White: Got into some promising positions with overlapping runs, but looked lightweight when defending. Replaced at the break. 5

Gabriel Magalhaes: Strong in tackles and decent on the ball, but not without his usual theatrics - went down injured then complained when told to leave the field as per the rules. 6

Ezri Konsa: Struggled to deal with Brobbey and looked unconvincing on the ball when pressed. Conceded penalty for hauling down Ballard. 4

Ricardo Calafiori: Solid as usual but didn't provide his usual offensive threat. 6

Myles Lewis-Skelly: Lucky to escape an early booking, sloppy on the ball and withdrawn at half-time. 4

Declan Rice: Hard-working as ever both with and without the ball. Created a great chance for Saka at 0-0, but otherwise a bit sloppy. Recognised opportunity to tee up Guimaraes. 6

Bukayo Saka: Should have opened the scoring but failed to make proper contact. Kept largely quiet and missed one-on-one chance late on. Won late penalty and scored - just. 6

Martin Odegaard: Unable to continue his blistering start to the season. Good free-kick delivery. 6

Christos Tzolis: Looked lively early on but faded. 5

Kai Havertz: Missed a clear chance at 0-0 but almost scored a brilliant effort minutes later. Tried to square when he had the chance to put the game to bed. 6

Jurrien Timber (on 45, White): Did a better job up against Angulo and Brobbey and proactive in winning the ball back. Headed in but caught offside. 6

Bruno Guimaraes (on 45, Lewis-Skelly): Brilliant strike moments after Raya's penalty save at a time Arsenal needed help. Not a bad way to score your first goal. 7

Subs not used: Kepa Arrizabalaga, Piero Hincapie, Viktor Gyokeres, Noni Madueke.

articles.title: Dos chispazos del Almería desmontan a un limitado Córdoba
articles.standfirst: Los indálicos logran sus primeros puntos de visitantes. Thalys, tras 4 partidos de sanción, marca en el primer balón que toca
articles.summary: Los indálicos logran sus primeros puntos de visitantes. Thalys, tras 4 partidos de sanción, marca en el primer balón que toca
articles.body: El Almería se llevó el triunfo en el duelo andaluz frente al Córdoba, abriendo así su casillero de puntos como visitante. El cuadro local, que puso voluntad pero demostró sus limitaciones en este momento de la temporada, vio cómo los tantos de Cipenga y Thalys decidían en la segunda parte en dos ramalazos de calidad. Thalys marcó en el primer balón que tocó tras jugar en Liga tras sus cuatro partidos de sanción la pasada temporada. El cuadro blanquiverde salió dispuesto a llevar el peso del partido y lo logró, aunque sin que llegara a sufrir verdaderamente el Almería. Generó saques de esquina, llegadas por banda y centros, pero la zaga del cuadro indálico estaba muy segura por arriba y por abajo. El Córdoba, que como siempre cargaba mucho por el lado de Carracedo, ahogaba la salida del Almería, donde sólo Cipenga crear superioridades aunque en andanadas individuales. El jugador congoleño iba a dejar su sello de calidad al regresar de los vestuarios, cuando, entrando a la espalda de Egoitz remató de primeras adentro un centro de Baptistao. El Córdoba, que había buscado la alternativa ofensiva de meter a Diego Bri de lateral y a Kevin por delante, pudo empatar en un tiro precisamente del ilicitano que sacó Andrés Fernández. García Pimienta retiró a Luna, con amarilla, para meter a Chirino, mientras Arribas volvía a jugar de rojiblanco por Baptistao. Ania buscó alternativas con Budesca en el lateral y Enol por Diego Percan arriba. El Córdoba buscó el desequilibrio con Carracedo, que puso varios centros sin encontrar rematador. En una contra, Kevin Medina recibió en buena posición, pero su disparo salió desviadísimo. La diferencia con Cipenga. Llegaron más cambios, y fueron decisivos. Una pérdida de Diarra, grave, permitió a Javi Muñoz encontrar a Thalys, que llevaba dos minutos en el campo, para anotar. Ania, que había tirado de Adnane Ghailan por Eder García, metió dos puntas, al situar a Víctor Sánchez por un silbado Diarra. Los blanquiverdes, con más corazón que cabeza, buscaron el tanto que les metiera en el partido, pero sólo evidenciaron sus limitaciones. Adnane Ghailan remató fuera en buena posición, un par de cabezazos se pasearon por el área pequeña rojiblanca e Isma Ruiz probó los guantes de Andrés. Víctor Sánchez llegó a batirle en el 92', pero en fuera de juego. El encuentro acabó con tensión con la grada, al ir Carracedo al sector de los ultras al pitarse el final

articles.title: Hablemos de Diomande...
articles.standfirst: La contracrónica del Real Madrid -Rayo Vallecano
articles.summary: La contracrónica del Real Madrid -Rayo Vallecano
articles.body: En la noche de Diomande, otra vez Arda. Y menos mal. En su versión corta, 15 minutos, el turco dio un recital para acabar con los pitos del Bernabéu y lanzar un mensaje: si alguien debe ser intocable en el Madrid, es él. Pero hablemos de Diomande. Aún no sabemos si es un crack o no. Y cuando has costado 140 millones eso es un problema, aunque no sea culpa suya. Pero sí, es evidente que el precio le va a perseguir mucho tiempo. Ante el Rayo, Mou le dio su primera oportunidad en el once y pasó de puntillas. Porque, y volvemos al precio, al fichaje más caro de la historia hay que pedirle más que dos buenas carreras por la derecha. Igual en la ubicación está el problema, porque Diomande siempre jugó en la izquierda. El Bernabéu por ahora le tiene fe y se porta bien con el chico, que al menos es trabajador. Pero no va a ser fácil encajarlo en el once, porque con la BMV intocable, su sitio debe ser para Arda Güler, el mejor del Real Madrid. Sin hacer ruido, Bernardo se adueñó del partido. O mejor dicho, de la primera parte. Obviaremos la siesta que se echó el Madrid en la segunda mitad. Hasta el descanso, lo que él quiso. Como si nada. El portugués es puro fútbol. Lo lleva dentro, en las piernas y en la cabeza. Formó pareja en el medio con Valverde y terminó haciéndose con el centro del campo por completo, dejando a Fede hacer lo que mejor saber, descolgarse para asomarse al área rival. Y mientras él, a jugar, haciendo que todo girara a su alrededor con sentido. Un grandísimo fichaje que puede valer oro en las grandes noches, por su calidad y experiencia. Y si Mou lo juntara con Güler... Por desgracia del Bernabéu, no coincidieron en el campo. El lateral izquierdo rompió el partido en tres minutos. Primero, forzando un penalti con Lejeune. Después, con un golazo tras una pared con Mbappé. Carreras vuelve a disfrutar de su mejor versión a las órdenes de Jose Mourinho, que ha sabido tocar las teclas adecuadas para levantarle el ánimo tras el final del curso pasado y el fichaje de Cucurella. El chico, lejos de hundirse, ha dado un paso al frente y vuelve a jugar con determinación y personalidad. No recuerdo quién fue el último entrenador que hacía a los jugadores activarse con ejercicios de velocidad tras salir del descanso. Con Mou, se acabó lo de salir del vestuario y quedarse parados hasta que el árbitro pite el inicio de la segunda parte. Algo tan básico para la mayoría de los equipos pero que en el Real Madrid no se hacía. El mejor del Rayo. De largo. El único que se resistió a la manifiesta superioridad del Real Madrid en la primera parte y que buscó la revolución en la segunda. Dejó su sello cada vez que tocó el balón y dejó una delicatessen con su toque de puntera para sorprender a Courtois y hacer el 3-1. Seis goles en cinco jornadas y mucho fútbol para llamar a las puertas de la selección. Raro sería que De la Fuente no le convoque el viernes. Ni cuando el Madrid gana bien Courtois pasa inadvertido. En una noche en la que el equipo blanco se puso 3-0, el belga tuvo que hacer cuatro paradones. Lo de siempre, ya sea Liga, Copa o Champions. Courtois es un seguro de vida para el Madrid y seguramente el jugador más determinante del equipo desde 2018. El turco salió a falta de 15 minutos para el final y sacó al Bernabéu del sopor y a su equipo del letargo de la segunda parte. De repente, los jugadores del Madrid encontraron un socio en cada rincón. Siempre Güler al apoyo para recibir y sacar su zurda a pasear. Un breve recital que dejó al Bernabéu con un mejor sabor de boca tras una segunda parte para olvidar.

articles.title: Beñat: "Estoy orgulloso de mis jugadores, aunque el resultado ha quedado muy lejos"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador rayista analizó en rueda de prensa la derrota en el Bernabéu
articles.summary: El entrenador rayista analizó en rueda de prensa la derrota en el Bernabéu
articles.body: Beñat San José analizó la derrota por 4-1 del Rayo Vallecano en rueda de prensa. Partido: "Hemos cometido el error del penalti, luego otro en salida de balón. El Madrid te castiga. Con balón hemos estado bien, hemos tenido buenas ocasiones y Courtois ha hecho grandes paradas, demostrando que es el mejor portero del mundo. Valoro el coraje y la constancia, seguir apretando arriba. Estoy orgulloso de mis jugadores, aunque el resultado ha quedado muy lejos". Cambio en portería: "No es definitiva. Creíamos que era buen momento para el debut de Emil (Audero). Ha estado bien, el Madrid es letal y es muy difícil parar ese tipo de goles. Estoy contento con su debut. Ha tenido buenas intervenciones y confiamos mucho en él". Mourinho: "Me ha saludado y me ha deseado suerte para lo que viene. Un caballero. Al equipo le he dicho de mantenernos firmes en la idea. Yo soy el responsable pero no tenemos que cambiar la idea, sí corregir. El Madrid, cuando te aprieta, es difícil sacar la pelota, por eso estábamos bien abiertos. Queríamos llevar la pelota de un lado a otro, además de seguir mentalmente fuertes. Ha sido una lástima que no hayamos metido el segundo, habría sido un chute de energía". ¿Qué es lo que más le enorgullece?: "Es el Rayo que queremos ver. Courtois ha sacado manos importantes, no a jugadas aisladas, sino a jugadas construidas desde atras. Lo que más me enorgullece es la perseverancia y la mentalidad de mis jugadores. No nos hemos escondido y hemos ido a por el partido". Camello: "Se ha quejado un poco de que el cambio ha tardado, ya que el tenía unas molestias. Le he dicho que estuviera tranquilo. Es un tipo espectacular, no ha sido nada más que eso. Sentía que si seguía algo más, se podía romper. Lo que ha estado en el campo, ha estado apretando. Se entrega por completo. No voy a descubrir yo a Camello, en las Olimpiadas ya demostró que valía. Ahora lleva muchos goles, otros años también lo ha hecho. Hay que seguir potenciando el atacante tan completo que es". Su carrera como entrenador: "Por naturaleza, me meto demasiado en los partidos. El estadio como tal, no me ha impuesto, no he estado ni un segundo fuera de la concentración del partido. Hay que felicitar al Madrid porque este estadio es extraordinario. Obviamente haber estado aquí, representado por mis jugadores, es un orgullo, aunque fastidiado por haber perdido. Estoy muy contento con mi equipo, con los jugadores que tengo. Es un equipo que quiere mejorar, escucha y es talentoso".

articles.title: Güler se ha hecho imprescindible
articles.standfirst: 'Al otro lado del espejo', una opinión de Alfredo Relaño
articles.summary: 'Al otro lado del espejo', una opinión de Alfredo Relaño
articles.body: Es difícil ponerle pegas a un equipo que acaba de ganar 4-1, pero si se tiene en cuenta que la victoria se labró sobre dos fallos infantiles en torno al primer cuarto de hora del puntal de la defensa rayista, Lejeune, y que desde le descanso hasta la salida de Güler, a falta de otro cuarto de hora para el final, el Rayo fue dueño del campo y el balón, la cosa se mira de otra manera. Empezando por lo último, lo de Güler fue una nueva demostración de que el turco es el jugador más en forma del equipo, el de mejor visión y capacidad de contagio, además de un preciso sacador de córners y de faltas al área. Lo de ayer fue palmario: el Madrid estaba a merced del Rayo desde el descanso, se había recortado el 3-0 en 3-1, pitaba el Bernabéu con volumen creciente y cuando Mourinho dispuso que Güler, que tenía día de asueto, entrara en el campo, aquello cambió radicalmente. Fue mano de santo. Pasó de jugarse en terreno madridista a lo contrario y pasamos de los sustos en la portería de Courtois, que volvió a ser muy exigido, a comprobar la rapidez de reflejos del nuevo meta rayista, Audero, hijo de indonesio e italiana, nacido en la tierra del padre pero criado en el de la madre, internacional italiano en toda la escala de formación pero que para la absoluta eligió Indionesia. Güler facilitó ya cerca del final el 4-1 a Mabppé, diluyendo el peso de los dos primeros regalos de Lejeune. Salió de inicio Diomande, pero hizo poco. Algunas cosas buenas, pero no muchas. Tampoco el equipo se volcó por allí. El que parece estarse quitándose la mufa de encima es Vinicius, que con el tono físico mejorado va recobrando confianza, aunque un descuido suyo contribuyó al gol del Rayo, obra de Camello. La cuestión es que el funcionamiento no aparece, lo que ya hace dudar si el funcionamiento es ese: esperar para salir corriendo con Vinicius y Mbappé. Y así fue ayer… hasta que salió Güler y en torno a él se tejió un juego elegante y útil que sirvió para mejorar la victoria y dejar un buen sabor final.

images.caption: Güler durante el partido entre el Real Madrid y Rayo Vallecano. Pablo Moreno

articles.title: Güler calmó los ánimos del Bernabéu
articles.standfirst: La opinión de José Vicente Hernáez
articles.summary: La opinión de José Vicente Hernáez
articles.body: Tenía toda la pinta este partido de acabar con una goleada del Real Madrid. Al descanso se fue con tres goles de ventaja que pudieron ser incluso cuatro de entrar ese zurriagazo de Mbappé que casi rompe el poste. Por eso no se entiende lo que pasó en el segundo tiempo. No se entiende lo que hizo el Madrid, claro. Cuando el Bernabéu estaba esperando una goleada resulta que hasta sobrevoló el temor a un posible empate. Y no es ninguna exageración. Verlo para creerlo. Todo empezó con un potente disparo de Pedro Díaz al poste desde lejos. Pero a renglón seguido un error infantil de VinIcius (un pase atrás cerca del área) propició el 3-1 de Camello, que para eso lleva tantos goles como Mbappé. Y el Madrid se puso hecho un flan, hasta el punto de que el Rayo comenzó a jugar con soltura, moviendo el balón sin oposición alguna. Se veía venir otro gol. Diez minutos después tuvo que intervenir de nuevo Courtois y entonces el Bernabéu se enfadó. Con toda la razón del mundo, caramba. El Madrid parecía el mal Madrid del día del Inter, ese Madrid que veía cómo jugaba el rival y no hacía nada por impedirlo. Ni que decir tiene que el centro del campo no funcionaba. No funcionaba porque no existía. A todo esto, Valverde se había quedado en el banquillo tras el descanso. Innecesario ese cambio. Valverde no se cansa jamás de los jamases. Mourinho reaccionó tarde, pero más vale tarde que nunca. Entró Arda Güler (también Tchouameni) y el partido fue como cuando en el teatro el mago se saca un conejo de la chistera. El Bernabéu se tranquilizó por completo. Los silbidos no se convirtieron en olés porque todavía le duraba el susto en el cuerpo. Arda Güler hizo magia, en fin, como el mago ese. Hasta pudo marcar un gol, luego dio un pase magistral a Mbappé (le hicieron otro paradón también a él) y al final acabó sirviéndole el 4-1 al Pichichi del Mundial. Más le vale a Mourinho que no se constipe el turco

articles.title: Akron fan play-caller’s drive ends in fumble: ‘Sorry, Marty’
articles.summary: That’s a bummer, Marty. Marty Whims II won the chance to call the Akron Zips’ first offensive series on Saturday as part of the school’s Offensive Coordinato...
articles.body:
Marty Whims II won the chance to call the Akron Zips ' first offensive series on Saturday as part of the school's Offensive Coordinator of the Game competition. It was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for a fan to finally prove whether they could call plays better than the coaches, as so many college football supporters have claimed from their couches over the years.

Whims had a lot invested in the moment. A Cleveland-based real-estate development company, he's also a Zips alumnus and multi-decade season-ticket holder. He beat out the likes of Barstool's Dan Katz for the chance to call plays, and he wasn't going to mess it up.

Instead, the players did the messing up.

Akron's opening drive against the Robert Morris Colonels started on their own 40-yard-line. Running a no-huddle offense, Whims put quarterback Christian Broughton in the shotgun, and on the first play he handed the ball to RB Jordan Gant for a 12-yard gain and first down.

On the next play, Broughton completed a pass to Kyan Mason for a two-yard gain, moving the chains. On 2nd and 8, Gant rushed for seven yards, setting up a critical 3rd and 1 call. A false start moved the Zips back to a 3rd & 5.

With his back against the wall, Whims called for a pass, and Broughton completed it to Marcel Williams , who appeared to have gotten the first down and kept this magical drive alive.

Alas, that's when the ball came loose, and the Colonels recovered. A dream extinguished, just like that.

If it's any consolation, RMU couldn't capitalize on the turnover, and Akron scored a touchdown on the ensuing drive.

But as for Whims, the whims of destiny just didn't see that touchdown coming, courtesy of his playcalling.

articles.title: José Mourinho: “There’s nothing but quality on the Real Madrid bench”
articles.summary: He spoke after a 4-1 win over Rayo Vallecano
articles.body:
Real Madrid coach José Mourinho spoke after a 4-1 win over Rayo Vallecano to praise his team, including impressive substitute Arda Güler, as he said: "Arda makes a big impact when he's on the pitch. I'm 100% certain that if Diomande hadn't started today, the first question would have been, 'Why isn't Diomande playing?' There's nothing but quality on the bench. The line-up changes will be made on a match-by-match basis. Arda has a very positive influence on the team's play. When he came on, he made all the difference in terms of the stability of our play."

Mourinho on the difference between the two halves

"I'd describe the match as a 45-minute affair. In 45 minutes, it was over. I knew the team didn't have the physical and mental strength to play the second half the way they did. The image that sums it all up is how Bellingham played in the last 10 minutes. Practically everyone made mistakes in build-up play, struggled to press, and with shots on goal… I already knew that. I expected it to be like that."

"I'm happy because we've been together for three months, although we can only really count from when we were all here. What we're doing has a lot of positives. We're taking it step by step, always trying to improve."

Mourinho on pressure to start Yan Diomande

"I'm a bit too old to feel the pressure. In football you can have different squads; sometimes you have to pray that nobody gets injured, other times you've got plenty of options. He'll keep improving bit by bit. He hasn't been at the top level for long and has a lot to learn tactically. But he's got incredible potential. In one-on-one situations, with his passing, shooting… He gives us loads of options. He can play where Vini does, on the right; Arda can play there too, or where Bellingham plays. Right now, I want to help him develop."

"Physically, he's in better shape than ever. He's just a millimetre away from reaching his top speed. His ability to sustain effort is immense. It's a process he's getting to grips with. Mentally, he's very strong; he knows Madrid better than anyone. He plays with a great sense of responsibility, that of representing Real Madrid and the Brazilian national team . He's calm. The goals will come."

"Simple. I want to win, and I want to win by as many goals as possible. When you're 3–1 up with five minutes to go, and Rayo have a very powerful full-back capable of creating danger… At that point, I felt it was best to shut the door. For me, the time for fancy footwork and scoring goals was over. Then we scored the fourth, even better."

articles.title: Arteta blasts 'unacceptable' Sunderland penalty despite Arsenal win
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta said the decision to award Sunderland a penalty could have cost Arsenal the Premier League title, even though his side emerged 2-0 winners at th...
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta said the decision to award Sunderland a penalty could have cost Arsenal the Premier League title, even though his side emerged 2-0 winners at the Stadium of Light on Saturday.

Sunderland had the chance to take the lead early in the second period when Ezri Konsa was penalised for wrestling Dan Ballard to the floor.

Arteta was furious as pictures showed Ballard was also pulling the England international as the pair fell to the ground inside the Arsenal box.

The decision ultimately mattered little as Enzo Le Fee 's spot-kick was brilliantly saved by David Raya .

Just two minutes later Bruno Guimaraes blasted Arsenal in front with his first goal for the club before Bukayo Saka 's penalty sealed all three points in stoppage time.

But the result did not hold back Arteta's ire towards the officials.

"We have to go through what was done today that in my opinion is not acceptable. I watched it 20 times and I cannot find a way to understand how they think to give a penalty in that situation or the way the VAR has not intervened," said Arteta.

"I don't know what to think really. I'm sad that we have to discuss in such a beautiful game something at this level that has the gravity of that because that changes the course of the season and it can cost you the championship.

"At this level, with all the work that we put in, this cannot happen."

Guimaraes was Arsenal's big-money recruit of the transfer window, but the £75 million ($87 million) signing is yet to start for his new club as Arteta has kept faith with Myles Lewis-Skelly alongside Declan Rice and Martin Odegaard in midfield.

The Brazilian was introduced at half-time and proved his worth with a brilliant strike to break the deadlock and silence the Sunderland fans that took aim at the former Newcastle captain.

Guimaraes also had a hand in Arsenal's second goal as from his pass, Saka was chopped down for the penalty.

"The personality that he has. He comes in and this is a special game for him as well, what it means for him, and how he grabs the game," added Arteta.

"The decisions that he's made and the two actions. The goal is incredible and the assist as well to Bukayo to put him through in front of goal, it's unbelievable as well."

A fourth win from four Premier League games takes the defending champions three points clear at the top of the table.

articles.title: Former UAlbany quarterbacks lift Utica over RPI football
articles.summary: Szalkowski spent his first four college seasons at the Division I Football Championship Subdivision level. He appeared in four games in two seasons at UAlban...
articles.body:
TROY - With a pair of former University at Albany quarterbacks at the controls, the Utica offense shredded RPI again on Saturday.

Former Great Danes backup Tyler Szalkowski completed 29 of 38 passes for 402 yards and a pair of touchdowns to lead the Pioneers to a 38-14 victory over the Engineers at East Campus Stadium.

"I enjoyed my time at Albany," said Szalkowski, who spent the 2021 and 2022 seasons with the Great Danes. "Everything they did for me just made me who I am today."

Utica improved to 2-0, while RPI fell to 1-1.

It was the second straight year Szalkowski picked apart RPI. He was 27-of-29 passing for 385 yards and six touchdowns when the Pioneers blew out the Engineers 41-14 in Utica last season.

Utica's offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach is Braeden Zenelovic, another ex-UAlbany reserve quarterback from 2019 to 2021. He was promoted to coordinator this season.

Szalkowski, a Rochester native, said Utica's offense shares "some of the same principles" as those UAlbany teams under then-head coach Greg Gattuso.

"We're speaking a different language, obviously," Szalkowski said. "Me and (Zenelovic) see the game really alike. We see the game through each other's eyes, which is great to have with an OC and a quarterback, so I'm grateful for him."

Szalkowski also appreciates having wide receivers Tyshawn Taylor and Gabriel Zawolo. Taylor, a junior from Syracuse, had eight catches for 244 yards on Saturday, eight yards shy of the s single-game record. He caught a 69-yard touchdown pass from Szalkowski to put Utica ahead 10-7 in the first quarter.

Zawolo, a senior from Rochester, had 13 catches for 104 yards and one score, a 4-yard touchdown in the second quarter. He was one reception shy of the Utica record.

RPI senior linebacker P.J. Poknis, who watched last year's Utica game from the sideline because of injury, led the Engineers with 16 tackles on Saturday.

"They've got a great quarterback and they've got a great scheme," Poknis said. "He's able to make any throw on the field, so hats off to (Szalkowski). Today, we were trying to get after him, and there's a couple of plays here and there where he got the better of us and that's going to happen with a guy like him."

Szalkowski spent his first four college seasons at the Division I Football Championship Subdivision level. He appeared in four games in two seasons at UAlbany and completed 2-of-4 passes for 28 yards.

He transferred to Robert Morris for the next two years. He appeared in seven games with two starts over the 2023 and 2024 seasons. He completed 30-of-47 passes for 239 yards, one touchdown and five interceptions.

Szalkowski dropped down to Division III Utica and has flourished the past two seasons. He threw for 3,638 yards and 33 touchdowns last year.

"It's been a roller coaster," Szalkowski said. "That's the best way to describe it. You now, starting playing D1 and then coming down and playing at Utica was one of the best decisions I ever made. I love Utica and I can't wait to keep going the rest of the season."

He said he wasn't quite certain how he got a sixth year of eligibility this season, though Szalkowski was confident he would play again when last season ended.

"I, honestly, am not sure," he said. "I think it was some sort of redshirt year that I had from when I was Albany or something like that. We figured that out and I was grateful to have another year."

RPI quarterback Micah Balzarini threw for 156 yards, a touchdown and an interception before taking a hit and coming out for Frankie Garbolino in the fourth quarter.

"We made our own mistakes," Engineers coach Ralph Isernia said. "Playing against a very good team, a very good quarterback like that, that's going to expose those mistakes."

articles.title: Mikel Arteta fumes over Sunderland penalty in Arsenal win: ‘Absolutely unacceptable’
articles.summary: David Raya saved the spot-kick but Arteta was furious with the decision against Ezri Konsa
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta hit out at the decision to award Sunderland a penalty before Arsenal scored twice to maintain an unbeaten start to the defence of their Premier League crown.

Bruno Guimaraes struck a ferocious shot in off the bar and Bukayo Saka scored a spot kick deep in added time to earn the Gunners a fourth straight win at a raucous Stadium of Light.

Yet Arteta was still furious with the decision by referee John Brooks to award the hosts a penalty early in the second half after Ezri Konsa was judged to have fouled Dan Ballard in the box.

Instead the Basque manager said Ballard, a former Arsenal defender, had performed a "judo roll" while insisting it should never be given as a foul.

Goalkeeper David Raya made a brilliant save to deny Enzo Le Fee's attempt from 12 yards, with Guimaraes scoring two minutes later.

However that did not stop Arteta from discussing his frustrations at full-time. "It's a huge win, but it could have been something very different," he told TNT Sports.

Pushed on whether he meant the penalty decision, which was awarded swiftly by referee Brooks and checked by VAR, Arteta added: "I'm so upset. It's unacceptable at this level. Unacceptable. This can change the course of a season, the championship.

"It's unacceptable. I've seen it 10 times to make sure, because I watched it live and I said, 'It's not possible at this level it's going to be a penalty.' Because it's a judo roll, that's what it is. It cannot happen

"I've been in football for almost 28 years, it's not a penalty in any case, in any game, in any context, in any league."

Arteta was earlier shown a yellow card for stepping outside of his technical area.

Asked about the save, Raya, who also denied Brian Brobbey late on, said: "I think that save made the players and the team to have that faith to keep going and win the game, which we did, and two minutes later we scored the goal, a wonderful goal from Bruno.

"But even if we conceded that goal, I think we had that faith to get back to the game. So obviously important to keep the clean sheet because that helped us to win games and important to save the penalty as well."

The Gunners are next in action away to Ipswich Town in the third round of the Carabao Cup on Tuesday evening before visiting Brighton on Saturday.

articles.title: ESPN's Chris Fowler on Texas-Ohio State, juggling tennis and football, and 'joke' scheduling
articles.summary: ESPN's top college football voice discusses his hectic travel week between two sports, a disturbing trend with non-conference football schedules and sizes up...
articles.body:
With assignments that include calling three of tennis' four major tournaments and ESPN's top college football game weekly through the playoffs, Chris Fowler readily admits he's living the dream.

His weekend travel itinerary, however, hardly seemed the stuff of dreams.

After calling Friday's second U.S. Open semifinal, he was on a private flight that landed in Austin around 3 a.m. Saturday. Following a scant amount of sleep, there was a late-morning production meeting before calling Saturday night's matchup between No. 1 Ohio State and No. 4 Texas on ABC, arguably the top non-conference matchup in college football this season.

Once Saturday's game ends, it's back on a plane to New York for Sunday's 1 p.m. CT men's final on ABC between Alexander Zverez and Blake Shelton, with the latter trying to become the first American man to win a major since Andy Roddick at the 2003 U.S, Open.

"They are my two favorite sports and I get to call the championship events in them," Fowler told the Houston Chronicle on Saturday afternoon during a brief respite in Austin. "So that's a dream job. I live in the dream I had since I'm 10 years old."

Fowler, at ESPN since 1986, has called tennis since 2003 and after a 25-season stint hosting "College GameDay," shifted to the network's lead college football play-by-play role in 2014.

This time of year almost always includes a juggling act between the Open and college football - he called LSU/Clemson in Baton Rouge, La., last Saturday - but this weekend arguably presents the biggest events he's called on back-to-back days.

Friday's semifinal between Frances Tiafoe and Shelton was the first between two Black American men during the Open era (since 1968). Ohio State-Texas is the third matchup between the programs since January 2025. Fowler will have called two of the three, the first being the Buckeyes' win in the 2024 CFP semifinals .

"I feel like this game is bigger than Oklahoma-Michigan was in this time slot a year ago and I think that the Shelton-Tiafoe match obviously was historic," Fowler said. "And there's a lot in it falling on (the 25th anniversary of) September 11th. It was a very involved, elaborate broadcast for numerous reasons. And then going back and doing the men's final with an American playing for it, trying to end a 23 year drought? So no, probably nothing (before compares) to the one-two-three punch of these days. Probably not equal to that."

Fowler's week also included calling a marathon five-set quarterfinal between Shelton and defending champion Carlos Alcaraz that took 4 hours and 28 minutes and ended at 3:33 a.m. ET on Wednesday in the latest finish in Open history.

"There's nothing quite like the scale of a big, long tennis match when you can be working five hours," Fowler said. "I've called a 5:53 match, almost a six-hour match before. It's a muscle you develop and you get used to those very long periods of concentration. And certainly (analysts) John and Patrick (McEnroe) are very dialed in for those long matches and and so that helps.

"But, yeah, 3:33 (a.m.), you just try not to look at the clock. I didn't have to get up the next morning and do anything. But you know you're going to be disrupted the following day. But that doesn't matter because it's a monster match; it's what you live for, to me. A tennis match when it's like that is as good as sports get. And I'm including a great football game. To me, tennis can be right on the top end of as compelling as anything in sports."

Fowler's tennis work also cut into his prep time for Saturday's broadcast with analyst Kirk Herbstreit and sideline reporters Holly Rowe and Laura Rutledge. For instance, he was on a Zoom call with Ohio State coach Ryan Day but had to drop out early after an Open match ended abruptly and he was needed back on tennis duty.

"I was working in a little bit of prep here and there, staying up late and doing football, but as I said, I'm going to be working right down to kickoff. which is not in the normal rhythm of the week," Fowler said. "I know I've got a lot of work to do to get ready for this game. I don't have one eye on tennis and one eye on football. You have to have both eyes on exactly what you're doing because it requires that, right? So there's no thought of football during (Tiafoe-Shelton).

"Now the minute it ends, on the ride to the airport, I got the chart out on the plane last night. I'm not sleeping. I'm looking at Texas State versus Texas (last week). I hadn't had a chance during the week to watch tape, and that's essential. So that that got pushed to Friday night in the wee hours, and I'm looking at my 38-page analytic report. Every aspect of this matchup dissected and it's a tremendous mountain of information that you don't want to smother the game with, but it's good to know it."

The Ohio State-Texas game represents what may be a dying breed of marquee non-conference matchups as more teams look to protect their playoff hopes. Fowler didn't mince words about that trend.

"I love the sport, and I hate what the pre-conference schedules have become," he said. "And you look around today - it's a joke. It's bad for the sport. I hope that there are repercussions for teams that don't schedule difficult, but will there be? That's up to the selection committee.

"They're not must-win games, but they're tone setters. And résumé builders and all that stuff. … (Many non-conference matchups) are exhibition games. I'd rather see a scrimmage than watch some of these games."

Fowler has called his share of high-profile Texas games during the Longhorns' first two SEC seasons and as always, expectations are high in Austin after an offseason overhaul via the transfer portal and Arch Manning entering his second season as the starting quarterback.

"I think Texas' talent that they've assembled is impressive," Fowler said. "They've addressed specific weaknesses. I think they feel like their O-line is better. They're better at running back. They're better at receiver (and) Arch's a year older. I think he'll play overall better than last year, but I think he'll pick up where he left off at the end of the season. And I think defensively, they've also addressed the needs in a less dramatic way than they did in offense (by) getting guys like Rasheem Biles and and getting guys like Colin Simmons back.

"I think there's pressure on Texas because I think this is a game that a lot of people feel they should win. These matchups, these are like heavyweight NFL games. It's hard to beat a good team three times in 18 months, right? That's what Ohio State's trying to do. And if they do it, it's really impressive. But I think Texas has a little bit of an edge. I'm not making a pick, just so you know, They've spent a lot of money, as you know, and made some smart (portal) acquisitions, and now they need to see those weaknesses that were apparent last year and begin to get exposed against the Buckeyes, they need to see those shored up for what they hope is a 15-, 16-game run,"

images.caption: It's a busy weekend for ESPN's Chris Fowler, who called a U.S. Open tennis semifinal Friday night, was in Austin for Saturday's Texas-Ohio State game and then was returning to New York for Sunday's men's final. (CFP/Getty Images)
